purpose: Ensure every generated Attach Packet carries freshness metadata and can be audited for staleness. The Attach Packet is DERIVED context — it must self-describe its freshness so consumers never mistake stale data for current state.

freshnessStatus.description: FRESH if all sources are within trusted threshold; STALE if any source mismatch detected; UNKNOWN if freshness cannot be verified

sourceOfTruthPaths.description: List of files checked to determine freshness

currentActivePhase.description: The actual current working phase (NOT last completed phase)

nextRecommendedPhase.description: From direction-guard, not derived from stale current_phase

archivedLegacyWarnings.description: Risks/warnings from legacy packets that are NOT active blockers

freshness_validation_rules.rule: If current_phase in conversation-space.json equals lastCompletedPhase in phase-ledger.jsonl, the state is STALE
freshness_validation_rules.action: Set freshnessStatus=STALE; use phase-ledger for lastCompletedPhase; consult active-thread.json for currentActivePhase

freshness_validation_rules.rule: If verifier JSON for a phase exists with status PASS, that phase must appear as completed (not pending/in-progress) in Attach Packet
freshness_validation_rules.action: REJECT packet if completed phase shown as pending

freshness_validation_rules.rule: Attach Packet next_actions must be derived from direction-guard nextRecommendedPhase, not from stale current_phase
freshness_validation_rules.action: If next_actions contains sub-steps of completed phase, flag as STALE

freshness_validation_rules.rule: Legacy risks older than 2 completed phases must be archived unless confirmed as active blocker
freshness_validation_rules.action: Move to archivedLegacyWarnings; do not list as active risks

freshness_validation_rules.rule: Attach Packet must include generated_at and mount_count so consumer can assess recency
If sourceOfTruthPaths fewer than 3, freshness is UNKNOWN
freshness_validation_rules.action: Set freshnessStatus=UNKNOWN; do not treat packet as FRESH

staleness_indicators: legacy rotation risks listed as active blockers
completed phase shown with status 'pending' or 'in_progress'
mount_count unchanged from prior mount (packet not regenerated)
generated_at older than latest phase-ledger entry
